facts.text: Maria shared a personal experience of financial hardship in her youth, during which she relied on assistance from her aunt.

evidence.quote: When I was younger, we had some money problems and had to rely on outside help from out auntie.

facts.text: John is currently involved in a community food drive aimed at helping individuals who have lost their jobs.

evidence.quote: I just started helping out with a food drive for folks who lost their jobs.
I wanted to help out in these tough times by doing a community food drive.

facts.text: John's motivation for starting the food drive was his observation of the impact of unemployment on his neighbors.

evidence.quote: Seeing the effect unemployment has on our neighbors made me decide to act.

facts.text: Maria previously connected someone with a nearby organization that provides housing and support for homeless individuals.

evidence.quote: I talked to him afterwards and linked him up with a nearby organization that offers housing and support for homeless individuals.
